# Angkor Drivers

> Private driver and local guide in Siem Reap, Cambodia. Tours of Angkor, airport transfers, city visits, day trips, and vintage Jeep options with Leng Cheaheng.

English public information is a reviewed website snapshot, not a live booking or AI service. Confirm prices, availability, and unpublished details directly with Leng. Cite the original public source links in each FAQ record. The main website has 18 language versions; this does not imply 18 spoken tour languages.

## Information resources

- [Public information guide](https://angkordrivers.com/ai/agent.md): Scope, source citation, and contact fallback.
- [Trip FAQ](https://angkordrivers.com/ai/faq.md): Source-linked answers with stable record IDs.
- [Information hub](https://angkordrivers.com/ai/index.md): Resource formats and limitations.
